candidate.title: scBS-seq
candidate.scope: The middle row labeled scBS-seq / Single-cell bisulfite sequencing, interpreted as the Smallwood et al. 2014 single-cell post-bisulfite adaptor-tagging implementation. Inventory: isolated single cell; Lyse; Methylated DNA; Bisulfite conversion; First random priming with Random primer 1 and Adaptor; Repeat 4 times and Extend; Exo I and purify; Second random priming with Random primer 2 and Adaptor; PCR; Align fragments from every unique molecular tag; Sequence. The return arrow denotes repeated first-primer synthesis, not a separate biological branch. The left methylation icon is explanatory; the neighboring scTrio-seq and scAba-seq rows have their own routes and are outside this card. PBAT is the embedded preparation strategy, not an additional target assay. Primary-paper details resolve primer structure, the capture interface and the final data interpretation; this is a schematic architecture, not a complete laboratory protocol.

method_scopes.rationale: All listed operations belong to the middle row identified by the card title and matching collection heading/caption. The Smallwood primary text and Figure 1a establish the five-round, post-bisulfite, two-random-primer implementation. scTrio-seq and scAba-seq are visibly independent neighboring rows, and PBAT is an embedded preparation strategy. No bulk-cell implementation or other bisulfite adaptation is added. The final data order and tag interpretation are explicitly resolved against the primary methods.
